text: I just installed. Its pretty good so far, except that if you set a negative habit, that you don't want to di, you're required to do it anyway, to keep your streak, & earn rewards. I also use habitica, & with it, when you do a negative habit, you lose health & gold. That actually discourages you from doing it. Requiring you to do it anyway, is exactly what you don't want, because it encourages you to do it. That makes no sense. The goal should be to do good habits, & NOT do bad habits.
author: bahrta sai
developer_reply: Hey! I totally get where you're coming from, but punishing you for not doing your habits is exactly what we don't want to do. The negative habits are meant to be checked off when you don't do them, for example "today I didn't eat junk food, checked!" and then you get your rewards for achieving that. This way, it positively reinforces you
